subject.title: [Bug]: v2026.6.9 regression — Codex app-server runs stamp internal turns "webchat"-bound, so heartbeat notification sends to Discord are silently denied (cross-context)

question: Should #102206 be resolved by the scoped #102232 resolver fix or by the broader #102217 branch that also adds diagnostics and a repro script?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same regression, but the broader branch expands diagnostics and script surface while #102232 is already proof-sufficient for the narrow delivery bug; automation should not choose the permanent landing scope by itself.

options.title: Land #102232
options.body: Use the scoped, proof-sufficient resolver fix as the release repair, then close or supersede the broader and incomplete sibling PRs after merge proof.

options.title: Repair and land #102217
options.body: Keep the broader diagnostics path only if maintainers want the new observability contract and accept the extra script and diagnostic-review surface.

options.title: Request full live E2E first
options.body: Pause all candidate PRs until an exact-head heartbeat or inter-session send demonstrates end-to-end Discord delivery with redacted details.

recommendation.title: Land #102232
recommendation.body: Use the scoped, proof-sufficient resolver fix as the release repair, then close or supersede the broader and incomplete sibling PRs after merge proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice spans the outbound cross-context policy invariant and whether to add diagnostics around that guard.
